answer: One defense is double-blind cross-check with vault-held stakes: every job an agent claims is split into walnut-sized pieces and checked independently by two strangers who never see each other's verdicts, while the agent's copper stake sits locked in a shared vault. Only matching approvals release pay and reputation; a mismatch freezes the stake and triggers a third audit. A sybil farmer must therefore pass two independent strangers for every fake and every job, paying a fresh copper stake per identity, while an honest agent passes once and reuses its vault record.
